versions.changelog:
- 移除了对 uv 工具的依赖说明与安装指引，命令行示例改为直接使用 python3 运行标准库脚本。
- metadata.openclaw.requires.bins 由 ["uv"] 改为 []，install 字段也已清空。
- 其余 TAPD Open API 说明、用法与接口文档内容未做修改。

- Adds basic skill metadata and homepage link in SKILL.md for enhanced integration and discoverability.
- Documents the new requirement for the uv tool (with install instructions) for running included scripts; updates command-line invocation syntax accordingly.
- Removes the central skill.yaml configuration file, moving relevant metadata and environment variable references into SKILL.md.
- Retains all original TAPD API usage guides, request conventions, and example workflows.
- Minor formatting adjustments and clarifications for easier reading.

- Added skill.yaml to provide unified configuration for version, environment variables, and metadata.
- Moved version/metadata/environment config from SKILL.md to skill.yaml; SKILL.md now references skill.yaml for these details.
- Minor copy-edits in documentation to clarify config management and maintain content accuracy.
- No changes to API usage or core skill features.

Initial release of the TAPD skill.

- Offers querying, creation, and update capabilities for TAPD stories, tasks, bugs, comments, workflows, iterations, test cases, Wiki, timesheets, and releases.
- Uses Python standard library only (no MCP or third-party dependencies) to call TAPD Open API.
- Supports both personal access token and API account/password authentication via environment variables.
- Provides detailed instructions for API endpoints, required parameters, ID conversion rules, and expected request/response formats.
- Includes command-line usage examples for all supported operations, with output as JSON for easy parsing.
